🇲🇽🌎 <u>100,000+ AT MONUMENTO A LA REVOLUCIÓN: "IF THEY WANT TO SEE THE TIGER AWAKE, LET THEM INVADE"</u>

Over 100,000 packed the Monumento a la Revolución to back Sheinbaum against the US-backed interference campaign. Víctor Hernández, one of the attendees: "the president is not alone — all Mexicans are the tiger, and if they want to see it awake, let them invade our homeland" — a direct echo of AMLO's 2018 line. Some carried banners crediting Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro for their families. The chant didn't stop: ¡Presidenta, no está sola!

🚨🇲🇽 <u>STAY IN YOUR LANE — SHEINBAUM TO US AMBASSADOR JOHNSON</u>

After US Ambassador Ronald Johnson posted on X that "la lucha contra los cárteles debe unirnos, no dividirnos," Sheinbaum's answer landed flat: "es importante que el embajador se quede en el tema bilateral y que respete los asuntos internos." Mexico's security is for Mexicans. Self-determination and non-intervention are written into the Constitution.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>ISRAEL'S ARMS EXPORTS HIT $19.2 BILLION RECORD — BATTLE-TESTED ON PALESTINIAN CIVILIANS</u>

Israel's Defense Ministry (SIBAT) reports defense exports reached $19.2 billion in 2025 — up 30% from $14.8B in 2024, the fifth consecutive record year. Sales have DOUBLED in five years. More than half of last year's deals were "mega-purchases" over $100 million. Asia-Pacific sales nearly doubled to $6.1B. Per SIPRI, Israel just surpassed the UK to become the world's 7th largest arms exporter. Countries that publicly pledged to boycott Israel quietly placed orders — buyers cite weapons being "battle-tested."

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO + CANADA SEND FORMAL LETTERS TO EXTEND TMEC 16 YEARS — UNITED FRONT</u>

Ebrard signed the official letter on June 1, addressed to USTR Jamieson Greer and Canadian Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc. Mexico's request rests on 30 sectoral forums and 32 state forums of public consultation. The demand is explicit: extend T-MEC 16 more years AND eliminate the Section 232 tariffs on steel/aluminum AND drop the Section 301 investigations. One month before the July 1 joint review under Article 34.7. Washington's response so far: silence.

🇲🇽✊ Dengue down 84% in two years — without privatizing public health. At Tuesday's health briefing, Health Secretary David Kershenobich presented the numbers: • 2024: 13,398 confirmed cases • 2025: 3,511 confirmed cases • 2026 so far: 2,136 cases, 4 deaths The strategy: the "5 steps for a mosquito-free home" community campaign plus Wolbachia-bacteria mosquito deployment in Yucatán and other states. Yucatán is down to 9 cases this year. — Dr. David Kershenobich, Health Secretary Public science. Public health. Public results.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 Mexico and Uruguay send food to Cuba — against a 60-year blockade. Sheinbaum confirmed at the podium that Mexico recently coordinated another humanitarian shipment to Cuba, with Uruguay joining. "Recently we sent food and supplies, and Uruguay participated. This is part of Mexico's commitment to the Cuban people — and to the principle that no people should be suffocated by a blockade." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on Cuba solidarity Mexico has voted against the US embargo at the UN every year. While Washington tightens sanctions, the region answers with rice, milk, and medicine.

🇲🇽✊ Free, public, and now stamped on the box. Sheinbaum announced that every medicine bought by the Mexican government in the next consolidated purchase will arrive with a printed label: property of the public health sector, free of charge. "It's not promotion. It's a measure to inhibit theft and resale in private pharmacies. People should know this was purchased with public resources and delivered free." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on stopping medicine theft Cofepris is already pursuing criminal complaints and pharmacy shutdowns. Public medicine stays public.

🇲🇽✊ "I don't believe teachers generated the provocation." After yesterday's CNTE march in Mexico City ended with clashes, opposition outlets rushed to blame the teachers. Sheinbaum refused the frame. "There was a lot of provocation yesterday. Honestly, I don't believe it was teachers who generated it. Dialogue with the CNTE continues — we will always privilege dialogue with every expression of the teaching profession." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on the teachers' mobilization A government that doesn't criminalize protest. The talks with CNTE remain open.
